Definition: a prolonged form of G2258; I was:--be, was. (Sometimes unexpressed).
BiblicalUsage: This is the first-person singular past of 'to be' — 'I was.' Jesus uses it looking back on His time with His disciples in John 17:12, and Peter uses it telling how he was praying in Joppa in Acts 11:5.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word 'was' carries the weight of a life already lived before God, and what we were is never hidden from Him.
